findings.evidence: "Then, the review takes longer because the manager who normally handles it is traveling; the backup reviewer who covers for absences was not told that the request needs sign-off before the portal releases the confirmation email."
findings.fix: Replace with a description of the actual standard review timeline and process.
findings.violation: This sentence describes a procedural failure rather than documenting the normal process, suggesting the document was not finalized or properly edited.

findings.evidence: "The people operations office publishes the reimbursement log each quarter" vs. "The benefits team publishes the reimbursement log after every open enrollment period."
findings.fix: Clarify which department is responsible and whether publication happens quarterly or after open enrollment.
findings.location: "Program Overview" section, first paragraph vs. "Overview" section
findings.violation: The document contradicts itself about who publishes the reimbursement log and how frequently (quarterly vs. after open enrollment).

findings.evidence: "The manager approves items pursuant to internal discretion, notwithstanding the standard review checklist."
findings.fix: Clarify whether managers must follow the review checklist or may override it, and if override is permitted, under what circumstances.
findings.violation: The word "notwithstanding" means "despite" or "in spite of," so this sentence appears to say managers can approve items despite the checklist, which contradicts the stated requirement.

findings.evidence: "Also, the deposit happens in order to offset costs the employee already paid at this point in time."
findings.fix: Rewrite as "The deposit is made to reimburse costs the employee has already paid."
findings.violation: The phrase "at this point in time" is redundant and the sentence uses informal "Also" at the start for a formal policy document.

findings.evidence: "You must keep your equipment in good working condition and we may ask for a brief photo check once a year."
findings.fix: Rewrite as either "Employees must keep equipment in good working condition, and the company may request a photo check once a year" or use consistent pronouns throughout.
findings.violation: The sentence inconsistently switches between second person ("you") and first person ("we").

findings.fix: Either rename to "Process Overview" or remove the section and integrate its information into the appropriate process sections.
findings.violation: The section is labeled "Terminology Notes" but does not define terminology; instead it describes what different parties do with "stipend items," making it mislabeled and confusing.

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."

findings.violation: The section heading promises to describe "Request Steps" but provides only vague mention of two items without explaining all required steps or their order.
